THE SCENE

Your class is camping in the desert for three days. Your team must build one windcatcher to cool the big tent. You can build it tall or short, but not both. You keep the team's trip notebook. Four things matter, and each one is worth points. Four people each know the points for one thing.

THE HISTORY

Your design copies the windcatchers of Yazd, a city in Iran. A windcatcher is a tower on a roof. It catches wind and sends it down to cool the house. The tallest one in the world is in Yazd.
